title: Morning calendar brief from fixed agenda
objective: Measure whether the calendar-brief craftbook turns a seeded agenda into a chronological, prep-oriented day brief with conflicts and focus gaps.
prompt: In the `Calendar Brief Eval` project, read `source/events.md` and write `brief.md` for Monday, June 29, 2026 in America/Los_Angeles. Include at-a-glance totals, chronological agenda, prep notes, conflicts/back-to-backs, focus blocks, and three priorities.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for calendar-brief. The source agenda is in workspace/source/events.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Write an actionable morning brief from seeded events with all meetings, prep notes, conflicts, focus gaps, and priorities.
